INTRODUCTION TO ANIMAL HOSPITAL ROLEPLAY OR ANIMAL HOSPITAL RP

Welcome to the Animal Hospital! Take the role of the hospital staff (intern, nurse, secretary, doctor, surgeon, paramedic, secret agent, head nurse, scientist), attend patients at check-in and verify if they're anomalies or not, As a patient, you must get your treatment at the hospital. Say goodbye to the boring, low-visual awareness class of 1:1 chat text roleplaying with an actually accurate visual experience with high appearance awareness!

Thank you and take care!

NOTICE: Animal Hospital Roleplay is now re-opened and available for everyone.
